invariants.rationale: The method dereferences 'data' to call stream(), so it must be non-null.
The method uses 'func' via throwingMapWrapper, so it must be non-null.
'collect(toList())' always returns a non-null List; result cannot be null.
The stream map operation produces one output per input, so sizes match.
If 'data' is empty, the stream produces an empty result and vice versa.
